Unseen Predator
TARGET RANGE:
50

Innate: Rengar generates Ferocity when he casts a basic ability or uses Savagery's empowered attack, which expires after a period out of combat. At max Ferocity, his next basic ability consumes them to become empowered with an additional effect, gain an extra cast, and briefly grant him bonus movement speed. Innate - Bonetooth Necklace: Rengar generates a permanent Trophy stack for each unique takedown against an enemy champion, gaining bonus attack damage. Innate: While in brush, Rengar gains Unseen Predator. Unseen Predator: Rengar's basic attack range is increased and causes him to leap to the target. This generates Ferocity on-hit if he had none at one point.
Innate: Upon casting a basic ability or using Savagery's first attack, Rengar generates a stack of Ferocity for 1 second, stacking up 4 times but not refreshing on subsequent triggers (unexpected). At maximum stacks, his next basic ability consumes them all to become empowered with an additional effect and grant him an additional cast along with 30% / 40% / 50% (based on level) bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds. Generated Ferocity is prevented from expiring for 10 seconds after dealing or taking damage, excluding damage dealt by damage over time or proc effects.
Innate: While in brush, Rengar gains Unseen Predator, which lingers for 0.35 seconds upon exiting brush. Unseen Predator is lost immediately if Rengar exits the brush using Flash or Hexflash.
Unseen Predator: Rengar's next basic attack on-attack generates 1 Ferocity if none of his current Ferocity was generated this way. The attack also has massively increased range and causes him to leap to the target's location if they are beyond his normal basic attack range, attacking the target upon arrival and landing 50 units in front of them.Rengar can cast any of his abilities during the dash. The start of the leap is the end of Rengar's attack windup, putting the attack timer on cooldown, triggering on-attack effects and additionally refreshing the Ferocity duration.
Innate - Bonetooth Necklace: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them grants Rengar a Trophy, once per unique champion and up to 5. An additional Trophy is made available through the event The Hunt is On! with the Head of Kha'Zix. Trophies grant bonus attack damage equal to 1% – 36% (based on Trophies) bonus AD.
"Spoils of the hunt!"

Rengar has a secondary resource bar that indicates how much Ferocity he currently has as pips.
Ferocity generated by Unseen Predator has a purple color.
Ferocity generated by his other abilities has a white color.
While out of combat, if abilities are used one after the other, only the first will count towards the 1 second Ferocity timer, without refreshing from the second cast. [1] (unexpected)
Reaching 4 Ferocity with an ability immediatelly grants access to empowered abilities, however reaching it with a brush attack will grant the access after a short delay - causing Rengar to still be able to cast normal abilities while at 4 Ferocity. [2] [3] (unexpected)
Only Flash and Hexflash instantly end Unseen Predator. Other blink effects will still cause the buff to linger upon exiting the brush area.
The attack deals basic damage but is considered ability damage for Spear of Shojin.
While grounded or rooted, Rengar loses the enhanced attack range from Unseen Predator.
Rapid Firecannon's and Savagery's bonus ranges are lost after 0.25 seconds upon gaining Unseen Predator, and are re-gained after 0.25 seconds upon losing Unseen Predator.
The same does not apply for other bonus ranges such as Hexoptics C44's.
Rengar will only leap to a target if his basic attack timer has been refreshed (if not so he will not automatically attempt to path towards his target, despite them being within leap range).
The leap will consume energized on-attack but only expend it once the leap hits.
If the leap is interrupted, the energized will be indefinitely stored in the background until expended by a successive leap. Only 1 energized may be stored, but another can continue to recharge on the buffbar.
While the energized is stored, normal basic attacks are prevented from expending any energized, however abilities may still expend the one from the buffbar. [4] (unexpected)
Rengar can freely use any abilities, summoner spells, or item actives while leaping.
Using a dash or blink ability will interrupt the leap.
The attack from the leap will:
Not go off if the dash was interrupted.
Not go off if the target becomes untargetable.
Go off at the end of the dash even if its normal destination is obstructed by boundaries he cannot cross (e.g. terrain, The Hextech Ultimatum).
Go off regardless of distance the enemy travels away from Rengar's original location.
Go off even if Rengar loses sight of the target.
Bonus AD percent from Bonetooth Necklace stacks recursively with Infernal Might, Overlord's Bloodmail's Tyranny and mid lane quest's bonus AD multiplier.
Bonetooth Necklace uses different icons corresponding to the number of stacks acquired:
1 Stack:
2 Stacks:
3 Stacks:
4 Stacks:
5 Stacks:
6th Stack: Head of Kha'Zix
Tips & Tricks
Since the attack timer is only put on cooldown at the start of the leap, Rengar can reset it mid leap (i.e via Savagery) to immediatelly perform a successive attack after leap end has hit.

Savagery
COOLDOWN:
6 / 5.5 / 5 / 4.5 / 4
CAST TIME:
none
Active: Rengar gains bonus attack speed for his next two basic attacks. His next basic attack deals bonus physical damage and will critically strike, dealing increased damage based on his critical strike chance. Ferocity Bonus: Savagery's damage is modified and Rengar gains bonus attack speed for a few seconds.
Active: Rengar gains 40% bonus attack speed on his next two basic attacks on-attack within 3 seconds.
His first attack on-hit is empowered to stab the target, having an uncancellable windup, gaining 25 bonus range, and dealing additional physical damage.
Additional Physical Damage:20 / 55 / 90 / 125 / 160 (+ 5% AD)
Ferocity Bonus: Savagery's damage is modified to deal 35 – 260 (based on level) (+ 20% AD) bonus physical damage. In addition to gaining another instance of the base attack speed on-cast, consuming the attack also grants 50% – 107% (based on level) bonus attack speed for 5 seconds.
Savagery resets Rengar's basic attack timer.

Casting Savagery does not break stealth.
The bonus attack speed from the unempowered and empowered casts can stack with each other, if both are cast shortly one after another.
The empowered attack windup may still be manually cancelled when targeting jungle plants or structures. [5] (unexpected)
Different attack speeds may desync the animation from the hit. [6] (unexpected)
Interrupting Unseen Predator's leap will shortly after replace Savagery's own animation with a normal basic attack animation. [7] (unexpected)
If energized kills the target before the attack hits, Savagery won't be consumed but it will still grant free Ferocity. [8] (unexpected)
Savagery's empowered attack is consumed against jungle plants.
While the Ferocity timer is not running, if the attack misses or is dodged it will grant a permanent Ferocity stack until the timer is triggered and refreshed. [9] (unexpected)
The additional damage is tagged as proc damage, basic damage, and spell damage, and applies other on-hit effects as well as life steal as normal.
It is also part of a separate cast instance - potentially allowing an extra stack of Eclipse and Electrocute (e.g while using Black Cleaver). [10] (unexpected)
The in-game extended tooltip incorrectly states that the additional damage is reduced against structures. [11] (unexpected)

Rengar's predatory instincts take over, Camouflaging him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.

COOLDOWN:
100 / 90 / 80
CAST TIME:
none

Passive: Rengar also gains Unseen Predator while camouflaged. Active: Rengar prowls for some time, gaining bonus movement speed. After a short delay, he also becomes camouflaged and gains Unseen Predator. During this time, Rengar will detect the nearest enemy champion in range, revealing them for the remaining full duration. As he approaches, he will mark the nearest detected enemy.
Rengar's next basic attack will deal bonus physical damage, then reduce the target's armor for a few seconds.
Passive: Rengar also gains Unseen Predator while camouflaged from any source.
Active: Rengar prowls for a duration, gaining bonus movement speed. After a 2-second delay, he also becomes camouflaged and gains Unseen Predator.
The camouflage can only last up to 14 seconds. (unexpected)
Effect Duration:12 / 16 / 20 secondsBonus Movement Speed:40 / 50 / 60%
During this time, Rengar will detect the nearest enemy champion in range, revealing and gaining sight of a 100-unit radius around them. Enemies detected are revealed for the remaining full duration.
The nearest detected enemy within 1600 range is also marked, alerting all of their allies within 1200 range about Rengar's presence.
Rengar's next basic attack within 125 range against any enemy or with Unseen Predator to the marked enemy deals 100% AD additional physical damage and then inflicts armor reduction for 4 seconds.
The target is revealed until the leap has finished.
Armor Reduction:15 / 20 / 25
Attacking or casting abilities other than Savagery ends Thrill of the Hunt immediately.

Thrill of the Hunt's duration starts on-cast.
It is not expected for the camouflage duration to be lower than the total effect duration. [13] (unexpected)
If a revealed enemy stealths, their true sight debuff will be removed, dropping aggro. [14] [15] (unexpected)
The debuff will be reapplied after 0.033s if they get back in range.
Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
Unlike other champions that break the stealth at the start of attack windup, Rengar may automatically start attacking a nearby target if the player's "Auto Attack" setting is turned on. [16] (unexpected)
The ability applies a mark on the target at the start of attack windup that is successively consumed when the basic attack hits to apply the effect.
If the attack is prevented or blocked (e.g. by knocking down Rengar when leaping) then the effect will not be applied.
The mark will however still linger for a very short period after that, allowing Rengar to consume it with a quick basic attack. [17]
The ability deals basic damage.
Unlike other ability empowered attacks (i.e Kled's Violent Tendencies, Malphite's Thunderclap), the additional damage is also tagged as proc damage - preventing triggering certain effects (e.g Malignance). [18] (unexpected)
It is also part of a separate cast instance - potentially allowing an extra stack of Eclipse and Electrocute (e.g while using Black Cleaver). [19] (unexpected)
The Unseen Predator buff may randomly end before a melee attack hits, causing the ability's effects to go through but without generating Ferocity. [20] (unexpected)
Rengar may sometimes be able to still leap away after consuming the ability with a melee basic attack. [21] (unexpected)
Rengar discerns a distinct heart beat instead of the usual true sight indicator. This indicator will be removed when out of range, but the target will remain revealed.
Thrill of the Hunt has an indicator that appears above the target(s) when Rengar is nearby. Some skins have a unique indicator.
